environment.hardware: MacBook Pro / Apple M1 Pro / 16 GB (same host recorded in earlier QA)
environment.mobileMethod: Viewport emulation on desktop; no agreed physical phone was tested

method: Read-only DOM lab observer: latest LCP, lifetime layout-shift sum and maximum observed event duration. These are local single samples, not field p75, full INP or session-window CLS.

budgets.note: Includes all 86 SSR-listed lazy swatches, all initial scripts including conditional polyfills, deferred renderer, HTML and CSS. Not a captured HAR transfer total. Renderer uses no external models/textures.

limitations: No physical mobile/GPU or cold/slow-network trace
No field traffic or Core Web Vitals guarantee
Reduced-motion paths code-reviewed; no OS preference matrix run
Viewport fallback code-reviewed; native fullscreen tested
Actual context loss verified in earlier isolated diagnostic; not repeated for final catalog import
Material appearance remains uncalibrated and illustrative
Hosted durable snapshots, share/export, enquiries and admin writes require persistent services; current hosted review uses device drafts and direct contact
